name: garba-music
description: Open, community-built Gujarati Garba catalogue and immersive music player.

scripts.seo:check: node scripts/lib/generate-static-catalogue-pages.mjs --check && rm -rf /tmp/playgarba-seo-check && node scripts/lib/generate-static-catalogue-pages.mjs /tmp/playgarba-seo-check && test "$(find /tmp/playgarba-seo-check/songs -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'index.html' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -eq 1169 && test "$(find /tmp/playgarba-seo-check/releases -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -type f -name 'index.html' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -ge 200 && test "$(grep -o '<loc>' /tmp/playgarba-seo-check/sitemap.xml | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" -ge 1300
scripts.check:modules: node --check simple-runtime.js && node --check provider-runtime.js && node --check player-continuity.js && node --check youtube-player-runtime.js && node --check nonstop-browser.js && node --input-type=module --check < app.js && node --check sw.js
scripts.check: npm run catalogue && npm run check:modules && node --check scripts/lib/generate-static-catalogue-pages.mjs && npm run seo:check && node --check scripts/report-playback-route-quality.mjs && node --check scripts/report-youtube-first-coverage.mjs && node --check scripts/validate-youtube-player-runtime.mjs && node scripts/validate-player-continuity.mjs && npm run automix:validate && node scripts/validate-runtime-packaging.mjs && node scripts/validate-youtube-player-runtime.mjs && node scripts/validate-runtime-song-routes.mjs && node scripts/report-playback-route-quality.mjs && node scripts/validate-discovery.mjs && npm run repo:validate && npm run docs:validate
